stemMd: A circle has centre (2,−1) and radius 3. Which point lies on it?
explanationMd: The point (2,2) shares the centre’s horizontal coordinate and is three units vertically above it. Its distance from the centre is therefore exactly the radius. The other distances are zero, √18 or four.

distractorRationale.b: This is the centre, not a point at radius three.
distractorRationale.e: Its distance from the centre is √18.
distractorRationale.a: Its distance from the centre is also √18.
distractorRationale.c: It is four units above the centre.
